dedupe_keys.name: industrial symbiosis network implementation abm local organic waste exchange for composting netlogo

description: An agent-based model of how actor behaviour, environment and business model design affect whether an industrial symbiosis network survives, and the cash flows of the firms in it. The CoMSES record says the model simulates a local waste exchange for compost production through the stages of awareness, planning, negotiation, implementation and evaluation: one central firm processes waste and negotiates with other firms to supply their organic residues, which otherwise go to an external incinerator, and a network counts as robust if it runs for 10 years without falling apart. Keywords include theory of planned behaviour, waste management and circular economy. Version 1.1.0 was published on 16 June 2021, is written in NetLogo for Windows, and is a free download under CC BY 4.0 with 304 downloads recorded. Coverage is a stylised local network. Caveats: a single waste stream (organic residues) and one central processor. For simulation it tests how fragile inter-firm waste and resource links are when partners leave, which matters for plants that depend on shared utilities. Related catalogue records include the Juanchito industrial symbiosis ABM and the SYMBA industrial symbiosis solutions database.
